content: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy. This process occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells and involves the absorption of sunlight, water, and carbon

Radioactivity is the spontaneous emission of particles or energy from the nucleus of an unstable atom. This process occurs when the nucleus has an imbalance of protons and neutrons, leading it to decay into a more stable form.
